spotlight.title: Click the PhantomBuster link TONIGHT — it dies tomorrow morning

The verification email's 72-hour link expires ~Aug 8 08:59Z — roughly 19 hours from this brief and one day before launch; after that the account re-verifies from scratch during launch week. Two fixes and one decision, in this order: (a) FIRST, settle with Frankie whether 'Chitraksh to VC USA' should run at all — it's an automated connection-request sequence aimed at the bucket Meeting 38 defined as relationship-first and 12-24 months ahead of a raise, so repairing the cookie without settling it just resumes the thing you said you didn't want; (b) click the verification email; (c) re-paste the li_at session cookie — five Aug 5 runs died on it and the phantoms are auto-paused. And note it doesn't unblock outreach on its own: LinkedIn Batch 1 is still unposted at 26 days and gates every sequence regardless.

spotlight.detail: Still your whole allocation, and it hasn't landed yet. One session unblocks four things — the founder-ad creative, a creative with your face, the landing-page refresh, and the ElevenLabs voice clone (audio is extracted from the same takes). Shirt + tie, iPhone at 4K/60fps per the kit, ~20-24 min, then hand the footage to Chitraksh. Second thing, five minutes, and nothing ships without it: your NPN, your CA producer licence number, and the not-guaranteed / rates-vary disclaimer. The old account was banned for exactly their absence — every Batch-1 creative and the landing page must carry all three before Aug 9.
